Container.Name: media_collection_auditor
Container.Overview: Media Collection Auditor automatically moves unneeded movies and TV shows through a safe Transient -> Holding -> Removal lifecycle using Jellyfin favorites/tags and optional Radarr/Sonarr integration. Start with DRY_RUN enabled and review the logs before enabling live changes.

Config.Name: Auditor Logs
Config.Description: Unraid folder where the auditor stores its state file and JSONL action log.

Config.Name: Media Library
Config.Description: Host folder containing the Movies, Movies_hold, Movies_keep, Movies_removal, TV, TV_hold, TV_keep, and TV_removal folders used by the auditor. Keep all lifecycle folders on the same filesystem.

Config.Name: Jellyfin URL
Config.Description: Jellyfin server URL, including protocol and port.

Config.Name: Jellyfin API Token
Config.Description: Jellyfin API key used to read favorites and tags.

Config.Name: Enable Movies
Config.Description: Enable movie lifecycle processing.

Config.Name: Radarr URL
Config.Description: Radarr URL. Leave as-is only if movie processing is disabled.

Config.Name: Radarr API Key
Config.Description: Radarr API key. Required when using Radarr for movie actions.

Config.Name: Enable TV
Config.Description: Enable TV lifecycle processing.

Config.Name: Sonarr URL
Config.Description: Sonarr URL. Leave as-is if TV processing is disabled.

Config.Name: Sonarr API Key
Config.Description: Sonarr API key. Required when using Sonarr for TV actions.

Config.Name: Dry Run
Config.Description: Safety switch. true only reports what would happen. Set false only after reviewing dry-run logs.

Config.Name: Allow Filesystem Delete
Config.Description: Permit direct filesystem deletion when a title is not known to Radarr/Sonarr. Leave false unless you intentionally want this fallback.

Config.Name: Allow Cross Filesystem Moves
Config.Description: Allow copy-then-delete moves when lifecycle folders are on different filesystems. Keeping this false is safer and preserves atomic same-filesystem moves.

Config.Name: Maximum Actions Per Run
Config.Description: Maximum successful hold/delete/season-prune actions allowed in one run.

Config.Name: Run Interval (Hours)
Config.Description: How often the container repeats. 0 runs once and exits; 24 runs once per day.

Config.Name: Movie Wait Days
Config.Description: Days a movie remains in the normal library before entering Holding when it is not protected.

Config.Name: TV Wait Days
Config.Description: Days a TV show remains in the normal library before entering Holding.

Config.Name: Holding Days
Config.Description: Days an item remains in Holding before moving to Removal.

Config.Name: Removal Days
Config.Description: Days an item remains in Removal before permanent deletion.

Config.Name: Reset TV Clock For New Episodes
Config.Description: When enabled, a recently airing TV show gets its waiting clock reset by new episodes.

Config.Name: Dislike Tag
Config.Description: Jellyfin tag that immediately qualifies a title for Holding.

Config.Name: Protect Tag
Config.Description: Jellyfin tag that permanently protects a title from lifecycle cleanup.

Config.Name: Enable Season Pruning
Config.Description: TV only. When enabled, older seasons of eligible kept shows can be pruned after the configured safety delays.

Config.Name: Keep All Seasons Tag
Config.Description: Jellyfin tag that prevents TV season pruning.

Config.Name: Season Prune Grace Days
Config.Description: Days a show must be in Keep before season pruning is eligible.

Config.Name: Season Prune New Season Delay
Config.Description: Days a newest season must exist before older seasons can be pruned.

Config.Name: Discord Webhook URL
Config.Description: Optional Discord webhook URL for run notifications.

Config.Name: ntfy URL
Config.Description: Optional ntfy topic URL for notifications.

Config.Name: ntfy Token
Config.Description: Optional ntfy access token for protected topics.

Config.Name: Generic Webhook URL
Config.Description: Optional generic webhook receiving JSON POST notifications.

Config.Name: Notify On Dry Run
Config.Description: Send notifications even when DRY_RUN=true.

Config.Name: Leaving Soon Digest
Config.Description: Include titles still in Holding in notifications.
